_doc: iLas2 laser lines and galvo calibrations, read by ilas.py. One line per QM2000 colour channel (1-6). calibration: name of a galvo calibration (Modular's TIRFCalibration.xml, or 'calibrations' below, which win). low / high: % of the channel range for 0 / 100 % power (Modular offset_low / offset_high). See ilas_README.txt.
